135    /**
136     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_identification_number#South_Africa
137     *
138     * @param bool   $citizen
139     * @param string $gender
140     *
141     * @return string
142     */
143    public function idNumber(?\DateTime $birthdate = null, $citizen = true, $gender = null)
144    {
145        if (!$birthdate) {
146            $birthdate = $this->generator->dateTimeThisCentury();
147        }
148        $birthDateString = $birthdate->format('ymd');
149
150        switch (strtolower($gender ?: '')) {
151            case static::GENDER_FEMALE:
152                $genderDigit = self::numberBetween(0, 4);
153
154                break;
155
156            case static::GENDER_MALE:
157                $genderDigit = self::numberBetween(5, 9);
158
159                break;
160
161            default:
162                $genderDigit = self::numberBetween(0, 9);
163        }
164        $sequenceDigits = str_pad(self::randomNumber(3), 3, 0, STR_PAD_BOTH);
165        $citizenDigit = ($citizen === true) ? '0' : '1';
166        $raceDigit = self::numberBetween(8, 9);
167
168        $partialIdNumber = $birthDateString . $genderDigit . $sequenceDigits . $citizenDigit . $raceDigit;
169
170        return $partialIdNumber . Luhn::computeCheckDigit($partialIdNumber);
171    }
